How It Works

Understand Mindathon in 30 seconds

Observe. Remember. React. Master. That's the whole experience.

Home/How It Works
01

Observe

Develop attention and visual awareness through engaging challenges.

02

Remember

Challenge memory and recall through interactive activities.

03

React

Build mental speed, accuracy and flexible thinking.

04

Master

Progress through increasingly challenging activities and develop stronger cognitive skills.

Keep it simple

No rules overload. Just play.

Mindathon is designed to be understood quickly. A host explains each challenge, everyone plays a round, and the next challenge begins.

  • Easy to start — learn each challenge in seconds.
  • Variety keeps it fresh — different challenges, different skills.
  • Works in groups — family, classroom or training centre.
